Next Point Condominium Rawai

Condominium in Rawai
HomeNew ProjectsNext Point Condominium Rawai

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

Next Point Condominium is an off-plan low-rise condominium in Rawai, southern Phuket, made up of four seven-storey buildings on a site of roughly 8,000 sqm. Units range from about 35 sqm studios to larger two- and three-bedroom apartments and duplex penthouses, with a pool, rooftop terrace, garden and fitness facilities. The developer is reported as AE Phuket Co., Ltd., a construction company.

Facilities & amenities

  • Communal swimming pool(s); one listing cites four pools including a rooftop infinity pool
  • Rooftop terrace with barbecue area and sun loungers
  • Landscaped courtyard garden
  • Fitness room
  • Lobby with reception
  • Recreation room
  • Elevators
  • Covered / underground parking
  • CCTV and 24/7 security

Frequently asked questions

Where is Next Point Condominium Rawai?

Next Point Condominium Rawai is a low-rise condominium project in Rawai, Phuket, developed by AE Phuket Co., Ltd.. Address: Rawai, Mueang Phuket, Phuket, Thailand.

What is the starting price of Next Point Condominium Rawai?

Agent advertised price is ฿3,150,000, last checked 2026-11-14. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

What ownership is offered at Next Point Condominium Rawai?

Sources list freehold ownership. Always confirm the exact title and conditions with a Thai lawyer before buying; this is general information, not legal advice.

When will Next Point Condominium Rawai be ready?

Current status: under construction. Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
